readout.label: Candidate Weil polynomials ruled out over F2

summary: The authors derive new necessary conditions on the zeta-function numerators (Weil polynomials) of K3 surfaces over finite fields. They compare the Artin-Tate formula over extensions and apply known lattice sphere-packing bounds to get lower bounds on special values. Applied to Kedlaya and Sutherland's candidate list over the field with 2 elements, the conditions eliminate over 50%. It only excludes candidates; it does not show the rest occur.
title: A cyclotomic Artin-Tate formula and sphere packing for K3 surfaces
